$comment: The reviewer's answer about one CodeQL stage-1 divergence (monitor/divergence-review.mjs): which analyst's verdict the evidence supports better, whether the disagreement comes from the prompt or verdict schema or from the evidence, and a suggested clarification. The analysts are labelled analyst-a (the local analyst) and analyst-b (the opus agent) only here and in the code that maps the answer back; the prompt never says which is which. A pointer for a human, never a classification, a severity or an override of either analyst. Enforced engine-side for the local reviewer (response_format.json_schema) and stated in the prompt for claude -p, whose reply is checked against the same fields. An unreadable schema refuses the review rather than accepting free-form output.

betterSupported.description: which stage-1 verdict the evidence in the prompt supports better, by the label the prompt gives it; both-defensible when each reading is supported, neither when the evidence supports neither

why.description: the evidence for that answer, citing the finding, the source context or the verdict text

disagreementSource.description: prompt-or-schema when the analysts read the instructions or class definitions differently; evidence when they read clear instructions against evidence that is ambiguous or incomplete

promptSchemaIssue.description: the kind of prompt or schema problem; none when the disagreement is in the evidence

suggestedClarification.description: the wording to add or change in the analysis prompt or verdict schema; empty string when none is suggested
